# `planroom-contract`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** every public type, `ErrorCode`, `WarningCode`, `Command` and `CommandSpec`.
- **May depend on:** its allow-list in `boundaries.toml`: `serde`, `serde_json`, `schemars`, `clap` (derive, and reading a leaf's derived arguments for its synopsis and flags), `uuid`, `indexmap` [DR-79].
- **Must not:** any other workspace crate or third-party crate; I/O, which its generated `clippy.toml` refuses as the kernel's does [DR-79]; logic beyond validation, the shaping of the schemas it generates (`schema::generate`, `draft_reply_schema`), and a leaf's synopsis and flags read off its derived clap arguments; any built-in pack kind or relation name as a string literal, with or without its pack prefix, or, outside tests, a built-in pack's level ID, since the kernel reads every constant here.
- **How to test it:** `cargo xtask test -p planroom-contract` (`tests/schema.rs`: the schema snapshot and round trips).

Read first, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [Contracts](../../docs/contributing/contracts.md); [One command catalogue](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#one-command-catalogue).
- **Records:** [DR-14](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-14-one-command-catalogue-no-mcp-server), [DR-21](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-21-agent-first-envelope-and-engine-authored-strings), [DR-37](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-37-one-schema-in-two-views-one-version).
- **Scenarios:** S15.

<!-- END GENERATED -->

## Layout

- `src/`: every public type, one module per part of the contract: the command catalogue (`command.rs`), the error and warning registries (`errors.rs`), the envelope, view models, events, cards, the pack manifest, requests, plan proposals and their results, the resolver's types, and `schema.rs`, which renders the two schema views; `lib.rs` re-exports them.
- `tests/`: `schema.rs`, the schema snapshot and round trips.
